It does not say that parallel legs were chosen, does not name the alternatives (skip on CI pass; a fifth `timeout-minutes` raise), and does not give the reason (the serial job used 58–93% of 135 minutes in runs 45518188323, 45734337628, 45927857867, 46009933351). The last two autofix runs deferred this as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED because the editor cannot edit the PR body, and supplied ready-to-paste text. The gap is still open on this head.
- requirement: "Runner use (§33): the gate runs about once a day. If the plan splits the job, the reason is §33.A's 'the combined job would come within 25% of its `timeout-minutes`'; state the jobs per gate run before and after in the PR body, and bound the fan-out with `max-parallel`." (linked issue Automation and wiring section)
  expected_change_site: PR description / body of the PR (runner-use rationale section)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The YAML half is done: `strategy.max-parallel: 2` under `validate-scripts` in `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, with the §33.A reason in the workflow comment. The PR body never states that `validate-scripts` went from 1 runner per gate run to 2 (bounded by `max-parallel: 2`). It also never states the §33.A reason, that the combined job came within 25% of its 135-minute `timeout-minutes`. The autofix editor deferred this as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, with ready-to-paste text. The gap is still open on this head.
